Engineering, San Francisco, Full Time
Frontend Engineer

About us

At Fernwood Labs, our mission is to help small teams spend their days on work that matters. Planning tools keep getting smarter—yet, most workshops and studios don’t know where to begin. We’re building software that shows teams where their hours go and helps them hand off the busywork.

The role

We are hiring a Frontend Engineer to turn Fernwood Labs’ product plans into reality. In this role, you will wear many hats: sketching, prototyping, and ultimately shipping frontend experiences in our planning products. Along with building, you will choose where engineering time goes, shape the technical foundation as we grow, and help build a kind and steady engineering culture.

What you’ll do

- Collaborate with Design, Research and Backend Engineering to build novel AI experiences
- Build beautiful, production-ready desktop and web experiences with React, Typescript, and CSS
- Set hiring and culture standards for Fernwood Labs’ engineering team

You’ll excel in this role if you

- Have 3-5 years of professional experience as a frontend engineer
- Are proficient with React and TypeScript, or another modern framework with willingness to learn React
- Have developed desktop apps with Electron that interact with system APIs
- Have solid experience with CSS frameworks like Tailwind
- Have a strong sense for clean design, accessibility, and polished experiences
- Love rapidly building user-facing products in a fast-paced environment
- Find joy in delivering AI magic moments to users
- Can convert vague specs into thoughtfully completed features
- Bring strong opinions about frontend architecture, and hold them loosely

Benefits and perks

- Top-of-market salary and equity
- Visa sponsorship
- Lunch stipends
- Generous health and dental insurance for you and dependents
- Unlimited PTO
- 401K

The Team

Our founders are Rowan Ellery, a former product lead at a fictional logistics startup, and Nadia Okonkwo-Hale, a researcher who has brought scheduling software to bakeries, boatyards and theatres. Our team are builders from fictional studios, schools and repair shops. Join us.

Backed by patient investors

We are supported with a $4.2M seed round led by Larkspur Ventures and Tidewater Capital, both fictional funds. Our angels include operators from fictional companies, including Ines Varga (Northgate Tools), Theo Brandt (Quarry Studio) and Ada Lindqvist (Harbor Works).
